texts.game: Your Xbox 360 disc of Beautiful Katamari as an .iso, or the folder it was extracted to (with default.xex and d02.dat-d05.dat).
texts.dlc: The game's downloadable content, as the Xbox 360 packages you have (LIVE or PIRS files), or a folder of them. The game installs them at its first start.
texts.settings: The game writes its settings file, katamari.toml, at its first start.
texts.footer: Beautiful Katamari is a trademark of Bandai Namco Entertainment. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Bandai Namco, Microsoft or Nintendo.
texts.movies: Re-encode the 6 movies to H.265 (recommended: 302 MB become about 115 MB, and the Switch's video hardware plays them). Needs a browser with an H.265 encoder (Chrome or Edge on a recent graphics card); without one, or unticked, the original WMV movies are kept.
texts.audio: Re-encode the music and voices to Opus (recommended: music 128 kbit/s, voices 32 kbit/s). Needs a browser with an Opus encoder (Chrome, Edge or Firefox); without one, or unticked, the original XMA sounds are kept.
